subject.title: [Bug] OpenClaw UI WebSocket reconnect 导致会话 terminated

question: Should WebChat reconnect recovery be considered satisfied by current main, repaired through a current-main replacement for #41067, or narrowed to a smaller active-run adoption fix?
rationale: The remaining behavior is a user-visible session-state contract, and current source shows partial mitigation without complete proof that in-flight runs survive reconnect correctly.

options.title: Replace or repair #41067
options.body: Rebase or replace the recovery PR on current main, keep the active-run contract explicit, and require live WebChat proof before closing this issue.

options.title: Narrow to active-run adoption only
options.body: Open a smaller fix focused on local chatRunId and busy-state adoption after reconnect, leaving restart transcript notices for a separate issue.

options.title: Close after live proof
options.body: If maintainers believe current main already satisfies the contract, require a real reconnect proof run showing an in-flight chat continues correctly before closing.

recommendation.title: Replace or repair #41067
recommendation.body: Rebase or replace the recovery PR on current main, keep the active-run contract explicit, and require live WebChat proof before closing this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: The current source surface and recent broad Control UI rewrite blame route the decision most directly through the current UI/gateway chat lifecycle owner trail.
